neha: Planning maintenance tonight 23:30-00:30 UTC (US-West + EU-Central). Runtime minor patch for scheduler fairness. We'll temporarily pause automatic model promotions and enable fallback routing for critical routes. No data changes planned.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by neha at 1766543210. Canary on ded-gpu-us-west at 23:35, staggered promote at ~23:50 if canary healthy.

chris: Drafting customer comms. Short statuspage blurb + enterprise note with release link. Rollback triggers: sustained >2% errors over 5m OR p95 +250ms OR token throughput drop >15% 5m.

sam_ops: Quick ops checklist: preflight 22:45 (warm caches), canary smoke at 23:35 (gen + embed), monitor p50/p95, error rate, qps. If canary fails: hold and rollback canary with `/deploy rollback --target=ded-gpu-us-west`.

Statuspage draft:
Scheduled maintenance: Minor runtime patch in US-West and EU-Central on DATE 23:30-00:30 UTC. Most customers should see no interruption; some requests may experience brief latency increases or automated fallback to alternative capacity. Automatic model promotions will be temporarily paused. Live updates: https://status.redwood.ai.

chris: SMS copy (short):
Redwood maintenance 23:30-00:30 UTC (DATE). Minimal impact expected. See https://status.redwood.ai for live updates.

neha: Please use wording "temporarily pause automatic promotions" in all customer-facing copy. I'll queue status publish at 22:50 and SMS at 23:10. Notify here immediately if we need to hold.
